description:
• Brand introduction: Ricardo Rojas, a renowned celebrity hair stylist, brings decades of expertise and artistry to his luxurious hair care line. With a career that spans working with some of the world's most iconic fashion houses and A-list celebrities, Ricardo has channeled his passion for beauty into a premium collection of hair care products designed to nourish, protect, and enhance every strand. His product line reflects the same attention to detail and commitment to quality that has made him a trusted name in the beauty industry.


• Product description: The Ricardo Rojas Hair Care line includes a carefully curated selection of shampoos, conditioners, treatment masks, and styling products, all uniquely infused with Yerba Maté extract. This powerful ingredient, known for its antioxidant and energizing properties, ensures that each product not only nourishes but also revitalizes your hair. Additionally, Ricardo Rojas offers seamless tape hair extensions, perfect for achieving red-carpet-worthy hair at home.


• USP (Unique Selling Point): What sets Ricardo Rojas Hair Care apart is its infusion of Yerba Maté extract, a potent, natural ingredient that revitalizes and nourishes hair from root to tip. This collection is designed by a celebrity stylist who understands the needs of hair in all its forms, ensuring every product delivers salon-quality results at home.


• Payment terms: 10% commission. Paid via Bank Transfer.


• Other information: Growing up in Tucuman, Argentina, Rojas studied the glamorous women seen in movies, magazines, even local Tango performances, and was captivated by the transformative power of hair. At an early age, Rojas began his practice on his Mother and Sisters hair at every chance, finessing their tresses with homemade concoctions to promote movement and a healthy feel to the hair. Through experimentation, Rojas learned that the one constant factor in making any hairstyle come alive was a strong foundation of well-nourished, healthy hair. It is a guiding principle he has never forgotten throughout his esteemed thirty-year career in Hollywood.
name: Ricardo Rojas
